eligible_panel.source: stage18 frozen species_join and sampled geography gates

background_selection.case_points: Retain every 10-km spaced sampled-range-constrained Pleistocene line point for 80 frozen species.
background_selection.background_points: Keep eligible 20-km regular-grid sites inside same species' surveyed/clipped polygons and >50 km from documented break lines.
background_selection.downsample_determinism: If background grid has >1000 sites, choose exactly 1000 with smallest SHA256('jensen20km-background-v01|'+lowercase frozen scientific binomial+'|'+format(longitude,'.6f')+'|'+format(latitude,'.6f')). No sampling based on climate or genetic response.
background_selection.aggregation: All species weighted equally at training and evaluation; background is availability-only pseudoabsence and is not a confirmed negative.

source_gis.source: UNEP-WCMC 2002 georeferenced ArcInfo GRID mtn_02g, EPSG:4326, 30 arcsec
source_gis.mask: values 1–7 mountain, 255 nodata/background; distance zero inside mountains and positive to nearest mountain class outside

source_gis.source: Natural Earth 10m lakes and rivers v5
source_gis.river_rank_rule: scalerank <= 3 (predeclared approximation, original paper didn't report its numeric major-river cut)

source_gis.source: EPA/CEC North America Level I codebook
source_gis.mask: Drop region NA_L1CODE = 0 (WATER); retain 15 land ecoregion codes
source_gis.topology: Use union of individual polygon BOUNDARIES; never union polygons and then take outer boundary

source_gis.source: EPA/CEC North America Level II codebook
source_gis.mask: Drop region NA_L2CODE = 0.0 (WATER); retain 50 land codes

same_product_climate.source: Original CHELSA-TraCE21k V1.0 SHA-verified C1 rasters
same_product_climate.focal: At each current locality, standardized Euclidean magnitude of its four local changes 21ka minus 0BP, training SD only
same_product_climate.modern: Original 0BP four variables from same climate product

baseline: Published original barrier family (mountain water eco I eco II TRI), modern climate 4 variables and WGS84 lat/lon; never claim exact original author csv replication.

inference.primary: one species-disjoint heldout delta-AUC for break vs surveyed-range background
inference.calibration: 200 no-history null and 200 effect-positive geographically correlated synthetic worlds on frozen 80 species case/background structure, fixed seed 20261029. Positive source-only calibration must pass before opening 21ka break outcome.
inference.uncertainty: species-cluster bootstrap, not point independent, evaluate 44 train 36 heldout species; 50km break-jitter sensitivity fixed independently of performance.
inference.claim_boundary: Per-program positive requires stricter 98.33% species-bootstrap CI excluding zero or new independent replication, in addition to original study-specific 95% CI; this is third distinct biological response target after He and Fst failures.

opening_gates: All geographic baseline reconstructed fields finite for >=50 species and >=20 in each frozen arm
All 8 original CHELSA 21ka/0BP variables finite for qualified sampled points and no biological result-dependent exclusions
Source and ensemble provenance hashes identical across independent replays
Synthetic false positive/power calibration passes before empirical AUC
No new cutoff, history predictor family or subgroups chosen after reading AUC
environmental_source_equivalence: NOT_EXACT_2024_ORIGINAL. Author's 2024 extracted environmental CSV input files absent from 3 published Figshare articles and bespoke river/lake polygons unavailable. All environmental controls independently reconstructed and explicitly labeled.
